description: This file declares the AampMediaPlayer class, which implements the Exchange::IMediaPlayer interface. It includes constructors, a destructor, copy constructor and assignment operator deletions, and a method to create media streams. The class is part of the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace.

classes.name: AampMediaPlayer
classes.description: Implements the IMediaPlayer interface, providing media stream creation functionality within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

methods.name: CreateStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a new media stream identified by the given ID.
